title: BBQ Pork Asparagus Fried Rice (Com Chien Xa Xiu Mang Tay) - Vicky Pham
ldName: BBQ Pork Asparagus Fried Rice (Com Chien Xa Xiu Mang Tay)
ldKeywords: BBQ pork fried rice, BBQ pork fried rice recipe, com chien xa xiu, fried rice with asparagus, leftover BBQ pork recipes, Vietnamese BBQ pork fried rice, easy fried rice recipe, pork fried rice Vietnamese style, stir-fried asparagus and rice, Asian fried rice with pork, quick pork fried rice recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 cups chopped cooked BBQ Pork (Thit Xa Xiu/Char Siu)
1 tablespoon chicken or mushroom bouillon powder
ldInstructionsRaw: In a large wok, heat up the vegetable oil on medium high. Swirl oil around so that it coats all the way up to the sides of the wok. Add garlic and stir until fragrant but not brown (about 15 seconds).

Add eggs and swirl the liquid eggs up to sides of the oiled wok. Push edges of the eggs into the center to allow any liquid egg to run into the now empty areas of the wok. When the eggs look mostly cooked and still slightly wet, break the eggs into small pieces with a wooden spoon.
Add mushroom/chicken bouillon powder, garlic powder, salt, sugar and ground black pepper. Toss everything together until combined. Top with green onions (optional) and serve.
